purpose: Source atlas for seamless dry earth, road, limestone path, sparse grass and rocky-ground pieces used to build one continuous runtime Bethany world.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production art for a respectful narrative Bible-study RPG
Primary request: create cohesive first-century Bethany game artwork in a warm stylized storybook-realism style, combining appealing gently cartooned shapes with believable human anatomy, linen clothing, limestone, clay, wood and vegetation
Style/medium: polished hand-painted game art, readable silhouettes, clean forms, subtle texture, not restricted to pixel art
Camera: consistent three-quarter top-down RPG camera unless a dialogue portrait is requested
Color palette: warm limestone, terracotta, dusty olive, muted blue, dark plum, sand and natural linen
Lighting/mood: soft natural Mediterranean light, reverent, human and emotionally restrained
Constraints: historically plausible first-century Jewish setting; consistent approved character identities and clothing; clear gameplay readability
Avoid: modern objects, fantasy aura, halo, magical beam, horror, theatrical poses, embedded text, letters, UI, frame, border, watermark

Use the approved Bethany world master exactly for style, camera, palette, materials and lighting.
Create reusable production game assets for one continuous outdoor world: seamless earth/road/grass/rock ground pieces plus isolated limestone houses, well, canopy, table, wall segments, doorway threshold, road marker, rocky ledges, tomb entrance and olive tree. Keep every object isolated with consistent camera and scale, no connected cast shadows, no people, no text or UI.

Reusable seamless dry earth, dusty road, pale limestone path, sparse grass and rocky-ground pieces with matching edges and no object shadows.

Revision target: composition and extraction layout only.
Change only: replace the mixed scenic-object sheet with a strict ground-only 4x4 atlas of sixteen equal cells, containing only edge-matching dry earth, dusty road, pale limestone path, sparse grass and rocky-ground variants, including straight, corner, junction and transition road pieces; no raised tile bases and no scenic objects.
Keep unchanged: approved palette, three-quarter top-down camera, hand-painted material style, texture scale, natural daylight and all exclusions.
Acceptance: all sixteen cells are ground surfaces in a regular extraction grid and no buildings, wells, walls, trees, caves, markers, arrows or props appear.

machine: Ground pieces occupy a regular extraction layout with no labels or gutters baked into the art.
No people, objects, object shadows, text, letters, UI, frame, border or watermark.
candidateCount produces exactly two review candidates.
visual: Dry earth, dusty road, pale limestone path, sparse grass and rocky ground match the approved Bethany world.
Matching edges tile without visible seams or lighting jumps.
Road width and surface scale remain consistent across straight, corner, junction and transition pieces.
Ground texture supports readable enlarged outdoor characters without excessive noise.

Row 2 loose empty burial-cloth strips; light dust patch; limestone rubble; sparse Mediterranean plant.

Avoid people, body, corpse, bones, gore, decay, horror, supernatural light or effects, fantasy particles, modern cemetery objects, connected scenery, tomb entrance, cropped silhouettes, text, letters, labels, UI, frame, border and watermark.
